title: The School Library
description: A short text about a school library and a girl who loves it.
instructions: Read the text about a school library, then choose the best answer (A, B, C or D) for each question.

paragraphs.text: Our school has a big library. It is on the second floor. It is open from eight o'clock to four o'clock.
The librarian is Mr Brown. He is kind and helpful. He helps students find good books. Students must be quiet in the library.
Kim goes to the library every Tuesday. She likes books about animals and space. She can take two books home for one week.

The library is a big, bright room. There are about five thousand books. There are also six computers and a big table for group work. Near the window, there are some soft chairs. Students like to read there.
Last Tuesday, Kim wanted a book about the moon. She could not find it. Mr Brown looked on the computer. The book was on a very high shelf. He used a ladder and got the book for her.

Kim must bring her books back after one week. Last month, she was late with a book. She was very sorry. Mr Brown said, 'That is OK, but please be on time next time.' Now Kim always brings her books back on time.

Every Friday, there is a reading club in the library. Students read a book together and talk about it. This week, they read a story about a little robot. Kim loves the club. She wants to be a librarian one day.
